# 852LAB · Hong Kong Atlas

The main Atlas entry opens the versioned V2 workspace. 852LAB is the publication platform powered by Urban Genetics.

- Main entry: https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/
- Versioned application: https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/previews/V2RC-20261106T052258Z/performance-1/?v=glass-1
- Runtime configuration: https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/previews/V2RC-20261106T052258Z/performance-1/site/v2-site-config.js
- Public entry manifest: https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/release-manifest.json
- Previous public context and historical counts: https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/releases/entry-V2.0.2-20261001-180221/atlas-context.md

The Atlas links Place, Building and Lot evidence. A Place report describes an analytical cell. Building and Lot reports distinguish their own evidence from their primary area context. The Urban Genetic Signature describes urban form and related conditions. Development Pressure is diagnostic. Renewal and Genesis are strategic screening lenses.

The report's Print action opens an A4 publication with a generation date in Hong Kong time, source geographies, coverage, method notes and page numbers. Each Market source retains its own geography, period and cohort. A source table may show a labelled filtered page of records. Missing observations, unassessed measures and numeric zero have different meanings.

Share map view or Share report to reopen the public configuration against available data. The URL carries a versioned fragment. Source searches and historical result values stay outside the link. A fixed PDF can be downloaded from the publication.

The generation date identifies the document. Source dates and the method identifiers recorded inside each report identify the evidence used. The older release manifest and its counts describe their archived release.
